name: free-games-claimer
description: Automatically claims free games and DLCs on the Epic Games Store, Amazon Prime Gaming and GOG.

notes.text: After install, configure your credentials by editing the config file located at: `/opt/free-games-claimer/data/config.env`
The script will run daily at 18:30 but you can also run it manually by executing: `systemctl start free-games-claimer`
When running you can access the VNC console at: http://[IP_ADDRESS]:6080
